thread:
maya: quick sync — hitting an off-by-one when serving Llama3-v1 with an explicit <BOS> in our chat template. prod smoke shows an extra leading token in outputs, not a model hallucination, seems tokenizer/serving interaction.
sam: can you paste the model + tokenizer paths?
maya: weights: gs://redwood-models/snapshots/llama3-24b/v1/weights.tar.gz, tokenizer: gs://redwood-models/tokenizers/llama3-24b-tokenizer-v1.json
dmitri: likely kv-cache + prefix caching race. if the tokenizer returns an explicit BOS token id and our prefix-cache assumes it's trimmed, we double-insert the BOS. seen similar when preserve_bos vs strip_bos flags disagree between tokenizer and serving.
maya: repro snippet:
```python
prompt = "<BOS>User: hi\nAssistant:"
toks = tok.encode(prompt)
# toks[0] == BOS_ID
```
tia: config check — model.yaml currently has `strip_bos: false` and `cache_prefix: true` for that model in the registry. that combination is a red flag.
sam: ok i'll open a tiny PR to set `strip_bos: true` for chat templates by default and fold in a validator that fails if `cache_prefix && !strip_bos`.
maya: also noticing padding interplay: when padding to a fixed seq len, preserving BOS shifts token indexes and causes pad alignment differences across batch members, which changes attention masking and downstream scoring. explains small reranker diffs we saw.
dmitri: add test: roundtrip normalizer -> encode/decode with/without BOS, and a small multi-example batch to assert same masked positions after normalization.
sam: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482 — adds `strip_bos: true` default for chat_template models + validator + unit test skeleton.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled to eng-ml-canary at 2026-03-17T15:12:00Z — will run tokenizer fuzz and the new validator.
maya: thanks — i'll run a targeted eval over promo & onboarding prompts and post a token-delta summary here (checking both prefix cache on/off).
sam: ping me with the results, if deltas are small i'll merge then promote. :thumbsup:
maya: noted. will follow up with CSV of token counts + a couple failing prompts if any.
